salt-grain.name: klayout-magic-pcells
salt-grain.title: PCells generated by Magic for sky130A, gf180mcuD and the IHP PDKs
salt-grain.doc: KLayout PCells for the devices and the via, contact, substrate-contact, guard-ring and well generators of Magic's PDK code, one library per PDK: sky130_magic (sky130A), gf180mcu_magic (gf180mcuD), sg13g2_magic (ihp-sg13g2) and sg13cmos5l_magic (ihp-sg13cmos5l). Each PCell asks Magic to generate the device and copies Magic's GDS output, so the geometry matches Magic's. Needs Magic and at least one of the PDKs.
